event_corrections.source: Banner at 3496.57-3496.70 reads 'Mini T-SPIN' with no 'Single' (fr/g3/bb.png); score rises only +300 at 3496.50 (67545->67845, a zero-line mini T-spin at level 3; a mini single would be 600, 900 with B2B after the TST) and then only drop points to 67907 by 3497.43; board rows unchanged 3496.53->3496.73 (fr/g3/p057a.png): the T spun into the slot cleared no line and the J that followed (spawn ~3496.57) cleared nothing.

The Z spawned ~4066.27 is hard-dropped at 4066.43 into the gap of the green/red row; a white line-clear band crosses the board behind the TETRIS banner at 4066.43-4066.57 (fr/g3/kk4.png, exact frames) and the score rises +616 (149411->150027 at 4066.43) = single 300 + REN 300 (REN 2 after the 4064.17 TSD and 4065.3 quad) + 16 drop. The next Z (4067.03) is the chain's existing single, clearing at 4067.23 before the KO (fr/g3/p063c.png).

The O spawned 4305.93 (nextcount shift OIZLT>IZLTO) drops into the last gap at 4306.10-4306.13 and clears both remaining rows; board empty at 4306.20 with PERFECT CLEAR banner 4306.27-4306.87 (fr/g3/p066.png). Score +4650 at 4306.20 (11124->15774) = double 900 + REN 150 + PC-double bonus 3600.

Phantom double: the I spawned 4306.27 is held (HOLD shows I at 4306.33), the S comes out and is placed at the left wall on the empty board at ~4306.47 with no line clear possible (fr/g3/p066.png); score rises only +36/+38 drop points (15775->15811->15849), no 900.

Last chain event is 3936.50 (the I placed at the left wall by 3936.67), so this lock is not counted. Caveat: the p2 board may begin moving one frame earlier (pts 3936.87), which would put the lock one frame after the tilt; counted because it shares the end_s frame in the tool timeline.
